: synthetic purine nucleoside analog w activity against HSV (types 1 and 2), varicella-zoster virus (VZV), and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV); stops replication of herpes viral DNA by competitive inhibition of viral DNA polymerase (selective toxicity), incorporation into and termination of the growing viral DNA chain, and inactivation of the viral DNA polymerase
